correctness.rationale: The cyclic carry-transition identity \(T=\sum_{j=1}^{m-1}2^{m-j}p_j+2p_m\) follows from all integer increments and the cyclic wrap; the prefix-parity map is bijective; nonconstant affine truth tables are balanced. Successive opposite dyadic blocks force each zero-run length to be \(2^t\) or \(2^{t+1}\), and balance plus run count fixes their multiplicities. A longest-dyadic-run splitting argument proves strict window-weight increase until saturation. The separate \(b=1\) formula, constants and \(b=n\) cases are checked. The standalone checker independently passed 2,280 word configurations and 1,020 complete enumerators.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The found results share definitions and some extremal consequences, but neither determine the transition-to-run-multiset bijection nor all nonsaturated multiplicities. In particular the minimum-distance theorem has no information about the 4(K−1) intermediate words.

value.rationale: Cyclic \(b\)-symbol read channels motivate complete codeword weight distributions beyond minima. The result solves all window widths in the naturally ordered infinite family \(\mathrm{RM}_2(1,m)\), with exact uniform multiplicities and a structural transition-to-run classification. It is not a repackaging of the standard Hamming weight enumerator or an increment of a finite numerical table.
